newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, steady after quiet London.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, steady after quiet London.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices were steady in Asia on Friday unable to pick up any clues from uneventful overnight trading in London or New York.
July Brent -- which takes over as the front month -- was untraded on SIMEX. It was quoted at $19.45/$19.57 per barrel, after London July futures shed five cents to settle at $19.49.
Brokers said the July contract was maintaining a $1.80 arbitrage against July NYMEX futures in the absence of other leads from the western markets.
Other Brent contracts were unquoted at midday.
NYMEX July futures, on the ACCESS system, was last traded at $21.29, unchanged from New York's level at the close overnight.
June NYMEX futures were down three cents at $21.27.
